title: Angi to Host Investor Day on November 17, 2026, in New York City
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Angi Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
[PDF Version](https://ir.angi.com/node/13396/pdf)


DENVER, Sept. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Angi](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=gubfc3RNkZ8a_l1XCt3ZgKGc730EdHcpZt6Vq3dkWFPeQsVoFjuKLfU3ko4jG549PutjyOKg1njiYhy-oUQltA==) (formerly Angie’s List) (NASDAQ: ANGI), a leading digital home services marketplace, today announced that it will host its 2026 Investor Day on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, in New York City.


Led by CEO Jeff Kip, members of Angi's senior leadership team will present the company's strategy and long-term outlook, including its AI-first product roadmap, a live product demonstration and financial framework.


Presentations will begin at 8:00 a.m., ET and conclude at approximately 12:00 p.m. ET.


Due to limited capacity, in-person attendance is by invitation only. A live webcast of the event will be available to the public.


The live and archived webcast of the event and accompanying presentation materials will be available in the Investor Relations section of the company’s website at[ir.angi.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=3FFaQQjY3yo73wg0gBK4cCgMSs2RgKxl-itwJ40OfhOJ0rqVHnXnAioT-QNGoKlRLNM8Jz0G95-nFJlge869bg==)


To learn more about Angi, visit[www.angi.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=9uFopeMP-CySkWJo3EThlBgXpQrhwyqXuaO54ecOveOFa1Au2uSkkZh7LorlnujX3XVtHEeVGS7UmXQ4FzDq3w==) .


**About Angi Inc.**
Angi (NASDAQ: ANGI) helps homeowners get home projects done well and helps home service professionals grow their businesses. Founded in 1995, Angi connects homeowners with skilled local professionals, from plumbers and electricians to remodelers and landscapers, and provides tools for researching costs, planning projects and hiring with confidence. Homeowners have turned to Angi, and our vast network of skilled home pros, for help with more than 300 million projects.
